description: This file defines an abstract class 'Table' within the 'com.romraider.maps' package. The class manages data tables used in the RomRaider open-source ECU tuning software, including table properties, data manipulation, visualization controls, and interactions. It primarily serves as a base class for specific table implementations, providing core functionalities such as scaling, data export/import, highlighting, editing, and comparison features.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: An abstract class representing a data table used in ECU tuning, providing properties and methods for manipulation, visualization, comparison, and user interaction within the RomRaider application.

methods.name: drawTable
methods.description: Abstract method for rendering the table visually.

methods.name: populateTable
methods.description: Abstract method for populating table data from a byte array input.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Abstract method to increase data values by a specified increment.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Abstract method to multiply data values by a specified factor.

methods.name: cursorUp
methods.description: Abstract method to move cursor selection up.

methods.name: cursorDown
methods.description: Abstract method to move cursor selection down.

methods.name: cursorLeft
methods.description: Abstract method to move cursor selection left.

methods.name: cursorRight
methods.description: Abstract method to move cursor selection right.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Abstract method for serializing the table data back into a byte array for saving.

methods.name: horizontalInterpolate
methods.description: Abstract method to perform horizontal interpolation across table data.

methods.name: isLiveDataSupported
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if live data viewing is supported for this table.

methods.name: isButtonSelected
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if relevant UI button is selected.
